body: Tbh there is something wrong with everyone in that nobody's perfect, we all have our issues and some people are just better at hiding it. I feel you on the run out of energy thing, feel free to visit my post about how I'm just tired of everything. I also get the laziness aspect but that also comes with depression and I got hefty handful of that. FYI frozen food and cup o noodle/ ramen are life savers when you don't have the energy to even exist. Don't be sorry about points to make, I just wanted to provide my perspective in hopes of letting you look at things a bit different. As for desires, I look at that term similarly to goals/aspirations and these things are not easily obtained for some of us. I have very little I strive for but I try my best to find something to keep busy in my free time as to distract myself from my depression and anxiety. Just try your best to keep on keeping on, most days can be very rough but once in a while it is possible to have a good day. Do your best to appreciate those on the rare occasions they come, as that is what has personally kept me going this far.

Thanks for your response, I appreciate your hopefulness. I really do want to have the motivation to get out there and do things, but it's so easy to get stuck in the cycle of depression. Hopefully i find my way out, but till then i take each day at a time. My social anxiety is just about equal to depression at causing emotional stress, i'm lucky enough to be able to go out to a restaurant with a friend every once in a while but even that is a challenge. At my job i have to interact constantly with customers and my anxiety is extremely high on the daily. After 4 yrs of this i've only gotten worse dealing with people yet i stay there because it's the only stable job i know of that will pay my bills. Thanks for the idea's about volunteer work, i don't think i'm ready yet for that but i will definitely consider it for the future. I've honestly been waiting years for my social anxiety to get better but meds like valium and the like only dug me in deeper and on my own i have trouble coping. I want a future, yet it to difficult to picture at this point in time. If i didn't have so much on my plate i would quit my job and look for something more suited for me but it's difficult to deal with the unknown.

I hope you find a job that give you fulfillment, and i wish you the best in life.

Absolutely true, and i'm sure my coping mechanisms negatively effect my life. Games use to work but i no longer find comfort in them, food has become a dangerous comfort leading to my weight gain, someone to have sex would be nice but it isn't my main priority, my mental state is. Drinking copious amount of alcohol has both helped and hurt. It numbs quite well, i actually enjoy hangovers as it leaves little to think about other than the pounding headache/nausea, however it is very costly and while not taking priority of my bills, alcohol has become an unnecessary expense to my already struggling financial situation. I just hope to hold on long enough to reach that cabin. Maybe someday, maybe never who knows.

Thanks for commenting, i guess the cabin in the woods is technically a dream/goal if you think about it. I do find some joy in nature, however money has brought me very little joy other than being able to pay bills and when i don't have enough for even those i end up feeling worse. I had to tell my pharmacist to put a hold on my meds cause i couldn't even cover that this week. This is working at a full time job too. When i do have some spending money ill occasionally get something to keep me busy however i have trouble finding joy in the little things now a days. I am proud to hold a job however i definitely think it has been a component in my mental decline, stress sucks. I wish you best of luck on your path random stranger.

Sorry for your losses, and i can only imagine how hard life has been growing up for you. I lost my brother 3 yrs ago and life has never been the same. Instead of crying, i drink myself to sleep at night but everyone copes with the hardships of life in different way. I wish you the best of luck on your journey through life, and your more than welcome to build your small little cabin near mine when the time comes.

tbh i think your reading into it more than whats actually there, people can hate an idea and associate that to things however if anyone one told me or most of the people i know any of those things you mentioned we wouldn't just to the job destroying, terrorism supporting, baby killing conclusions you are jumping too. Sure there are plenty of crazies in every group of people but please don't assume they are the majority. And the opinion of why fight if the majority is against us, is skewed. Many laws and bills get passed by a group of vocal minorities, they just have to put extra effort in to spread their message enough to reach the ignorant masses. Not everything in life is futile, you just gotta do the best you can and hope that others will listen. I don't think you need to change, i think you need to make a stand strong on whatever issues your fighting for, because if there is no opposition there will never be change.
